tagline: Share Odoo records with secure links, copy formats, QR bridge, and share history
problem: Teams waste time copying record URLs manually, lose context in chats, and have no audit trail of what was shared.
solution: Record Share adds Copy Link, a share wizard, multiple formats, email and WhatsApp helpers, optional QR bridge, and per-user share history on key business documents.
benefits: Copy secure record links in one click from sale orders, contacts, leads, invoices, and products
Share as URL, Markdown, HTML, JSON, or record name
Permission checks before any link is exposed
Email and WhatsApp helpers with pre-filled messages
Optional bridge to Universal QR Generator when installed
Share history with configurable retention cleanup

features.title: Copy Link
features.text: Stat button copies the record URL or your configured default format instantly.

features.title: Share wizard
features.text: Popup with previews, copy actions, email, WhatsApp, and open-in-new-tab.

features.title: Multiple formats
features.text: URL, Markdown, HTML, JSON, and plain record name for docs, chats, and tickets.

features.title: Access control
features.text: Links are generated only when the user can read the underlying record.

features.title: Share history
features.text: Audit log per user with action type, format, and timestamp.

features.title: QR bridge
features.text: Generate QR codes through Universal QR Generator when that app is installed.

workflow: Pick a format or send via email or WhatsApp
